login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Warehouse Management System
login.locked: This account is temporarily locked after too many failed attempts. Try again later or ask an administrator.
login.required: Enter your user name and password.
login.network: The server could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.
login.serverError: Something went wrong on the server. Please try again.

changePassword.title: Choose a new password
changePassword.forced: You must choose a new password before you can continue.
changePassword.hint: At least 8 characters, different from the current password.
changePassword.tooShort: The new password must have at least 8 characters.
changePassword.mismatch: The two new passwords are not the same.
changePassword.wrongCurrent: The current password is not correct.
changePassword.same: The new password must be different from the current one.
changePassword.failed: The password could not be changed. Please try again.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.noData: Live figures will appear here once the warehouse modules are connected.

md.deleteText: {{name}} will be deleted. This cannot be undone.

error.stale: This record was changed by someone else - reload
error.inUse: This record is still used by other records and cannot be deleted.
error.forbidden: You do not have permission for this.
error.session: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
error.server: Something went wrong on the server. Please try again.
error.network: The server could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.

help.code: Letters, digits, _ . - ; stored in capitals; unique.
help.transfer: A hand-over position between pieces of equipment.
help.capacityHu: How many handling units fit on one location of this type.
help.container: Other handling units can be placed in or on this type.
help.levelNo: Floor or storage level; locations are drawn per level in the layout view.
help.position: Position in millimetres, used by the layout view.
help.enabled: A disabled location is switched off completely.
help.blockedIn: Nothing may be put into this location.
help.blockedOut: Nothing may be taken out of this location.
help.blockReason: Required when the location is blocked.
help.externalRef: Address of this location in the PLC or host system.
help.extAttributes: Project-specific extra fields as JSON text, e.g. {"zone":"cold"}.
help.huTypeEmpty: Leave empty if the link is valid for all handling-unit types.
help.linkEquipment: The equipment that performs the move (optional).
help.cost: Routing cost; routes with the lowest total cost are preferred.
help.parentEquipment: Optional: the equipment this one belongs to, e.g. a conveyor line that contains transfer units.
help.plcConnection: Connection details for the PLC (used in a later phase).
help.equipmentEnabled: A disabled piece of equipment is not used for transport.

bulk.tooMany: At most {{max}} rows can be changed at once.
bulk.reasonText: This will be applied to {{count}} selected location(s). Enter the reason; it is saved with each location.

equipmentTypes.title: Equipment types
equipmentTypes.builtInHint: Built-in types are fixed and cannot be changed or deleted.
equipmentTypes.helpSuper: Built-in types are fixed. You can add your own types and change or delete them.
equipmentTypes.helpOthers: The list of equipment types is shared by all projects. Only a super administrator can add types.

assign.huTypesHelp: Tick the handling-unit types that may be placed on locations of this location type.
assign.locationsHelp: Add locations one by one, or add all locations of an area and/or matching a text at once. Nothing is saved until you press Save.
assign.tooManyMatches: {{count}} locations match - narrow the search (at most {{max}} at once).
assign.placedInHelp: Tick the handling-unit types that {{code}} may be placed in or on (for example a carton on a pallet). Optionally limit the quantity per carrier.
assign.badQty: The maximum quantity must be a whole number of at least 1, or empty for no limit.

import.title: Import from spreadsheet
import.intro: Load master data from a CSV or Excel file. Nothing is changed until you have checked the file and pressed Apply.
import.stepChoose: Choose table and get the template
import.step1: 1. Choose the table and download the template
import.step2: 2. Upload the file and check it
import.orderHint: Load the tables in the order of this list (areas first, assignments last): a row can only refer to records that already exist. A row whose code already exists updates that record; a column left out of the file keeps its stored value.
import.noFile: No file chosen (.csv or .xlsx, up to 10 MB)
import.nothingToDo: The file is correct but contains nothing new: all rows are already in the system as they are.
import.readyToApply: The file is correct. Nothing has been changed yet - press Apply in step 3 to save it.
import.fixFirst: Correct the rows with errors in the file and check it again. Apply is only possible when there are no errors.
import.truncated: Only the first {{count}} rows are listed (all errors are always shown).
import.applyHelp: All rows are saved together. If anything goes wrong, nothing is saved.
import.confirmText: {{table}}: {{created}} new, {{updated}} updated, {{added}} added. All rows are saved together or not at all, and every change is written to the audit log.
import.applied: Import applied: {{created}} new, {{updated}} updated, {{added}} added, {{unchanged}} unchanged.
import.refused: The import was refused and nothing was saved. See the rows with errors below.

validation.title: Check configuration
validation.intro: Looks for the mistakes that most often break a go-live: links to nowhere, storage that nothing can reach, equipment without locations, and more. This only reads - nothing is changed.
validation.summary: {{errors}} rule(s) with errors, {{warnings}} with warnings, {{passed}} passed.
validation.checked: Checked {{locations}} locations, {{links}} links and {{equipment}} pieces of equipment in {{ms}} ms.

layout.title: Layout preview
layout.intro: The plant as a picture, built from the locations and links in the master data. Look only - to change something, click a location and open its record.
layout.noLocations: There are no locations yet. Create locations (with x / y positions) or import them first.
layout.nothingOnLevel: No location on this level has an x / y position, so there is nothing to draw. Add positions to the locations.
layout.planCounts: {{locations}} locations and {{links}} links on this level
layout.withoutPosition: {{count}} location(s) on this level have no x / y position and are not shown.
layout.crossLevel: {{count}} link(s) lead to or from another level (for example a hoist) and are not drawn on this plan.
layout.planLabel: Plan of the locations of one level
layout.planHelp: Drag to move, mouse wheel or +/- to zoom. Zoom in to see the codes and the direction of the links. Click a location for details.
layout.noRacks: No racks found. A rack is a group of locations with an aisle and a column number.
layout.usable: {{usable}} of {{total}} locations are usable (enabled and not blocked)
layout.occupancyLater: Occupancy by stock is shown once the inventory is connected.
layout.duplicates: {{count}} location(s) share a column and level with another location in this aisle side (outlined in purple). Check the column and level numbers.
layout.unplaced: {{count}} location(s) of this aisle side have no column number and are not shown.
layout.dupCell: more than one location in this cell
layout.rackHelp: Columns run left to right, levels bottom to top. Click a cell to see the location.

placeholder.title: {{section}}
placeholder.body: This area is planned for a later release.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The page you are looking for does not exist.

users.title: Users
users.search: Search name, user name or e-mail
users.usernameFixed: The user name cannot be changed.
users.passwordInfo: A temporary password is generated when you create the user. You will see it once; the user must change it at the first sign-in.
users.superOnly: Only a super administrator can change this account.
users.ownRolesFixed: You cannot change your own roles.
users.ownAccountFixed: You cannot disable your own account.
users.ownPassword: To change your own password use "Change password" in the user menu.
users.enabledHelp: A disabled user cannot sign in, and is signed out at once.
users.resetText: A new temporary password will be created for {{name}}. The old password stops working and {{name}} is signed out. The user must choose a new password at the next sign-in.
users.tempWarning: Write it down or copy it now - it is shown only once and cannot be looked up later. Give it to the user in person or by phone, not by e-mail. If it is lost, reset the password again.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.intro: Every sign-in, user change and master-data change is recorded here and cannot be edited. Click a row to see the values before and after.

roles.title: Roles
roles.intro: A role is a set of permissions. Tick what each role may do. The built-in roles (with a lock) are fixed; create your own roles for anything else.
roles.superOnly: Only a super administrator can change roles. You can look at them here.
roles.copyFromHelp: Optional. You can change the ticks afterwards.
roles.codeHint: Capital letters, digits and _ ; starts with a letter; cannot be changed later.
roles.saved: Role {{name}} was saved. People who have this role are signed out and get the new rights at their next sign-in.
roles.help: Changes take effect at the next sign-in; people who hold a changed role are signed out when you save.

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.intro: Everything the product can allow, grouped by module. The list is fixed in the software and cannot be edited; roles decide who holds which permission.

groups.title: User groups
groups.intro: A group has roles and members. Every member gets the roles of the group in addition to the roles he or she has directly, so a user can be in several groups.
groups.membersHelp: People are signed out when their group changes, to get the new rights.
groups.externalRefHelp: Optional and not used yet: the name of the matching group in Active Directory / LDAP, for the sign-in integration planned later.
groups.enabledHelp: A disabled group gives its members nothing.
groups.rolesHelp: The members inherit all permissions of these roles.
groups.superOnly: This group carries the SUPER_ADMIN role: only a super administrator can change it.
groups.deleteText: Group {{name}} will be deleted. Its members keep their own roles but lose the roles they had through this group.

effective.groupsHelp: Group membership is managed under Administration -> User groups.
effective.title: Effective permissions ({{count}})
effective.help: Everything this user may do: the permissions of the direct roles and of the roles of all enabled groups. A workstation can restrict this further.

wsGroups.title: Workstation groups
wsGroups.intro: A workstation group can limit what people may do at its workstations - for example only view master data at the shop floor, however many rights they have in the office.
wsGroups.allowedNone: Nothing ticked: no restriction. People have all their own permissions here.
wsGroups.allowedSome: Only the {{count}} ticked permission(s) are available here, and only to people who have them anyway.
wsGroups.superKeeps: A super administrator always keeps the right to manage workstations, so this can never lock administration out.

workstations.title: Workstations
workstations.intro: The PCs, handhelds, HMIs and kiosks that use the WMS. A browser becomes a workstation when an administrator registers it; any other browser is in office mode.
workstations.locationHelp: Optional: where it stands (a location from the master data).
workstations.groupHelp: Optional: the group decides which permissions are allowed here.
workstations.checkIpHelp: The browser only counts as this workstation when it connects from the IP address above.
workstations.ipNeeded: Enter the IP address to check.
workstations.enabledHelp: A disabled workstation allows nothing: use it to take a device out of service.
workstations.notRegisteredInfo: No browser is registered as this workstation.
workstations.thisBrowserIs: The browser you are using now is registered as {{code}}.
workstations.registerThis: Register this browser as this workstation
workstations.registerHelp: Open Administration -> Workstations on the device itself and press the button there. Registering again replaces the browser registered before.
workstations.registerText: The browser you are using now becomes workstation {{code}}. A browser registered before stops being valid.
workstations.revokeText: The browser that is registered as {{code}} becomes an ordinary office browser.
workstations.saveFirst: Save the workstation first; then you can register a browser.

workstation.tipRestricted: Some permissions are not available at this workstation.
workstation.tipDisabled: This workstation is switched off, so nothing can be done here. An administrator must enable it.
workstation.tipIp: This browser is registered as a workstation but connects from another network address, so it is treated as an ordinary office browser.
workstation.tipStale: This browser was registered as a workstation, but the registration is no longer valid (browser data cleared, or registered again elsewhere). It works as an office browser. An administrator can register it again under Administration -> Workstations.
workstation.tipOffice: This browser is not registered as a workstation: office mode, no workstation restrictions.
